laws.rule: Using cameras, binoculars or GPS devices, or maps near government buildings or infrastructure is illegal. Don't take photos or film people without their permission, particularly around government buildings or key infrastructure. Your equipment may be confiscated, and you may be the subject of prosecution or police questioning. If you do this, local police may detain or question you.
